qualification.order: R then PQ then QB per input; no cost admission until all four pass
qualification.full_logits: All PQ/QB target and draft saved vectors byte exact including discarded verification rows
qualification.geometry: actual q2,physical key256/512,GQA32/8,36 target layers on B570

timing.warmup: Each arm executes old16token prompt once, in balanced order, all checked against PR133 reference; reported separately, never treated as free
timing.input_order: cycle input index by process; arm order row=(process+input)%4. Each input/arm appears in each arm position once.
timing.primary_window: service_seconds: fresh context creation/graph reserve, both prefills when speculative, proposal/verify/host sample/state, final sync and context destruction. Excludes shared model loading, comparisons and disk writes.
timing.secondary_window: request_seconds: inside fresh contexts, includes prefills and generation. Both windows include full host logits copy/finite check and cycle-record work. R measured with draft model resident, no draft context.
timing.cold: First-use requests are explicit warmup records. Shared persistent driver caches not reset; no claim cold-boot measurement.
timing.stages: Existing per-decode synchronized wall durations, role/phase separated; no extra synchronization or node observer during timing. Residual host/other time remains unassigned; not GPU critical-path attribution.

analysis.primary: Per-input geometric mean of QB/mean(PQ_A,PQ_B) service ratios over4 sessions; equal-input geometric mean. Request-only ratios reported separately.
analysis.secondary: QB/R service ratio, draft economics; also per-input lengths/acceptances and actual geometry.
analysis.practical_screen: All inputs qualified; primary reduction>2%, greater than largest per-input aggregate absolute A/A relative imbalance; QB faster than dualPQ in all4 process-level panel aggregates. Failure => no established practical panel benefit, not equivalence.
analysis.uncertainty: Four fixed exposed inputs and4 sessions onone date; descriptive ranges and all paired blocks. No population CI/pvalue, no cross-date or held-out claim, no optional stopping for positive result.
analysis.failure: First support/reference/capture failure stops entire panel before any further GPU execution; preserve failed input and unexecuted cells; no qualified speedup from partial pass subset.
